headline: Sensex and Nifty recover as IT stocks lead and crude oil prices drop, with Nifty near 22,700

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Cooling crude oil prices provided relief to benchmark indices after recent slides.
Strong buying interest in the IT sector helped drive early morning market gains.
Rising U.S. bond yields and global macroeconomic factors continued to weigh on sentiment.
Index rebalancing and stock-specific order wins spurred targeted investor activity.
whatHappening: Sensex rose around 100-200 points while Nifty traded near the 22,700 mark in morning trade.
IT and media sector stocks led gains, while pharma stocks saw downside pressure.
BSE entered the Nifty index as Wipro exited as part of the index reshuffle.
Inox Clean Energy filed its DRHP for a massive Rs 10,000 crore IPO.
summary:
Indian benchmark indices rebounded in early trade today as IT stocks led the recovery and falling crude oil prices boosted market sentiment.
Stock-specific developments included index rebalancing with BSE joining Nifty and Wipro exiting, along with Power Mech Projects rising on a new order win.
Despite today's recovery, broader markets remain on track for a weak monthly closing amid persistent global headwinds.
